name: Philips Avent Bottle_Nipple - 1 month plus - 2pcs
description:
Brand: Philips Avent
Product Type: Baby Bottle Nipple / Teat
Quantity: 2 pcs
Age Group: 1 month+ (suitable for newborns and preemies)
Origin: Made in Indonesia
Material: BPA-free silicone

Features & Benefits

Natural Breast-Like Design: Wide, breast-shaped nipple makes it easier to combine breastfeeding and bottle feeding.

Ultra-Soft & Flexible: Comfort petals and spiral design provide softness and flexibility for natural latch-on.

Anti-Colic System: Twin valve ensures air flows into the bottle, not baby’s tummy, reducing gas and fussiness.

Controlled Milk Flow: Smaller hole size provides slower, more controlled feeding for newborns.

Easy to Clean: Dishwasher safe or hand wash in warm soapy water.

Compatible: Designed for use with Philips Avent Natural feeding bottles.
